title: Blog post front matter (content/tr/posts/<bundle>/index.md and content/en/posts/<bundle>/index.md)
description: Validated by scripts/lint_posts.py (rule FM019) after YAML parsing (dates are parsed as strings). Cross-file rules (TR/EN pairing, uniqueness, bundle name = EN slug, lastmod honesty) are not expressible here and live in the linter itself. Language-dependent enums are selected with if/then on the `lang` the linter injects as `_lang` before validating; `_lang` is never written to files.

_lang.description: Injected by the linter from the directory (content/tr or content/en). Never present in files.

title.description: Page title, H1 and social title. Main keyword early. Recommended 30-60 characters (warning above 60). Hard limits 15-70. No trailing period, no clickbait, no emoji, no site name.

description.description: Meta description and card text: a real one- or two-sentence summary of what the reader gets. Recommended 120-160 characters (warning outside). Hard limits 100-170. Unique site-wide. Must differ from title.

date.description: First publication, ISO 8601 with offset (Europe/Istanbul). Never changed after publishing. Same value in TR and EN.

lastmod.description: OPTIONAL. Only after a real, meaningful content update (see lastmod policy). Absent = the post has not been meaningfully updated since `date`. Must be later than `date` and not in the future. May differ between TR and EN.

slug.description: URL segment: /posts/<slug>/ (TR) or /en/posts/<slug>/ (EN). Lowercase ASCII, digits, single hyphens, 3-75 characters. EN slug must equal the bundle directory name. Existing TR slugs never change (indexed URLs).

postType.description: Drives the anatomy and the image mix. project = something Furkan built; contribution = an OSS PR/issue story; guide = tutorial/how-to/reference; story = experience/opinion/career.

tags.description: 3-6 tags from the controlled vocabulary, same English slugs in both languages, no duplicates.

categories.description: Exactly one category in the page's language (pairs: MCP ve Yapay Zekâ/MCP & AI, Açık Kaynak/Open Source, Python, Backend, DevOps, Trading, Web3, Projeler/Projects, Deneyimler/Stories).

series.description: OPTIONAL. At most one series, named in the page's language. Omit the key when the post is in no series (no empty lists).

aliases.description: OPTIONAL. Old URLs that redirect here (Jekyll-era paths only). Absolute site paths with trailing slash. Omit when empty.

cover.description: OPTIONAL. Bundle-relative path of a custom cover that should also be the og:image. Omit to use feature.webp (hero) and the generated social card.

coverAlt.description: Alt text for the cover/hero in the page's language: what the image shows and why it matters, 20-160 characters. Not the title, does not start with 'Image of', 'Görsel', 'Resim'.

canonical.description: OPTIONAL and rare: only when the canonical original lives on another site. Absolute https URL.

syndicate.description: OPTIONAL, EN only. false keeps the post off dev.to. Default true.

noindex.description: OPTIONAL. true adds robots noindex and drops the page from the sitemap.

showTableOfContents.description: OPTIONAL. Override the site default (TOC on). Set false only for posts under ~800 words or with fewer than 3 H2s.

x-pairs.description: Read by the linter for TR/EN pairing checks.
